question:
Which of the following euphemistic expressions given in the alternatives has the meaning?

A bathroom.
option_1: The smallest room in the house
option_2: The corner room of the house
option_3: The outdated room in the house
option_4: The neat room in the house
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option A - The smallest room in the house.

'The smallest room in the house' is a well-known euphemism used to politely refer to a bathroom or toilet, avoiding the direct mention of its function.

question:
Which of the following idioms given in the alternatives has the meaning?

The most noticeable problem, or the loudest complaint, is the one that receives attention and is addressed first.
option_3: The squeaky wheel gets the grease
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option C - The squeaky wheel gets the grease.

'The squeaky wheel gets the grease' means that the most conspicuous or vocal problem/complaint is the one that gets attention and is resolved first, just as a squeaking wheel is the one that gets oiled.

question:
From the alternatives given below, select the correct meaning of the idiom.

Throw spaghetti at the wall and see what sticks.
option_1: To be very active and energetic to the point of hyperactivity
option_2: To escape, flee, or abscond from prison
option_3: To make a large number of attempts or guesses, with the expectation that at least some of them will be correct or useful
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option C - To make a large number of attempts or guesses, with the expectation that at least some of them will be correct or useful.

'Throw spaghetti at the wall and see what sticks' is an idiom meaning to try out many different approaches or ideas without being sure which will work, hoping that at least some will succeed.

question: Choose the correctly spelt word from the given options.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option D - Playwright.

The correct spelling is 'Playwright' - a person who writes plays. The other options are common misspellings that incorrectly substitute 'wright' (one who makes/creates) with 'right' or 'write'.

question: Choose the correctly spelt word from the given options.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option C - Inconvenience.

The correct spelling is 'Inconvenience' (meaning trouble or difficulty). The other three options rearrange or misplace the vowels incorrectly.

question:
Select the option with the correct spelling that can replace the underlined word in the given sentence. If the spelling in the given sentence is already correct, choose Option “No replacement required”.

The long, hot summer days seemed to enarvate him, draining his energy completely.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - enervate.

The correct spelling is 'enervate' (meaning to drain of energy or vitality). The word 'enarvate' in the sentence is a misspelling and should be replaced with 'enervate'.

question: Choose the word that is the most appropriate synonym of the word "clever".
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - Intelligent.

'Clever' means quick to understand and having sharp intelligence. 'Intelligent' is its closest synonym, while 'Foolish', 'Naive' and 'Clumsy' all convey the opposite or unrelated qualities.

question: Choose the word that is the closest synonym to the word "pulled".
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option A - Dragged.

'Pulled' means to apply force to move something towards oneself. 'Dragged' is its closest synonym, whereas 'Pushed' is its antonym, and 'Stopped'/'Rejected' are unrelated in meaning.

question: Choose the word that is most opposite in meaning to "anxious".
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - Calm.

'Anxious' means feeling worried or nervous. Its direct opposite is 'Calm', meaning free from agitation or worry. 'Nervous', 'Worried' and 'Restless' are all synonyms of 'anxious', not antonyms.

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of Fortunately.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option A - Unfortunately.

'Fortunately' means luckily or by good fortune. Its antonym is 'Unfortunately', meaning unluckily. 'Luckily', 'Happily' and 'Thankfully' are all close synonyms of 'fortunately'.

question: Choose the word that is the antonym of Gaining.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option D - Losing.

'Gaining' means obtaining or acquiring something. Its antonym is 'Losing', meaning to be deprived of something. 'Acquiring', 'Winning' and 'Earning' are all synonyms of 'gaining'.

question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who collects stamps.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - Philatelist.

A 'Philatelist' is a person who collects and studies postage stamps. A 'Numismatist' collects coins/currency, a 'Curator' manages a museum or collection, and 'Collector' is too generic a term.

question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A person who collects coins.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - Numismatist.

A 'Numismatist' is a person who collects or studies coins and currency. An 'Archaeologist' studies ancient artefacts and sites, a 'Historian' studies history in general, and an 'Economist' studies economics.

question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A short version of a written text with only the main points.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option A - Precis.

A 'Precis' is a concise summary of a text that retains only its essential/main points. An 'Extract' or 'Excerpt' is a portion taken directly from a larger text, while an 'Epilogue' is a concluding section added to a literary work.

question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition/prepositional phrase in the following sentence.

_________ the latest census, the population of India is around 1.46 billion.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option D - According to.

'According to' is used to indicate that information is being cited from a particular source, such as a census, report, or person. 'Because of', 'Owing to' and 'Due to' are used to express reason/cause, not the source of information, and don't fit the sentence.

question:
Select the correct alternative to fill in the blank with the correct preposition/prepositional phrase in the following sentence.

Prepare the project _________ the instructions given in the manual.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - according to.

'According to' is used to mean 'as stated by' or 'in agreement with' a set of instructions, rules, or a source, making it the correct choice here. The other prepositional phrases do not convey the sense of following given instructions.

question:
In the given question, a sentence is divided into four parts and given in the alternatives (A), (B), (C), and (D). There is an error in one part. Choose the alternative containing that part of the sentence that has the error. Choosing the alternative with the error will be the answer.

It is 14:25 hours now and the arrival/ time of the train is 14:30 hours, so we/ have to wait for five more minutes, and/ the train is going to come to the station within five minutes.
option_1: It is 14:25 hours now and the arrival
option_2: time of the train is 14:30 hours, so we
option_3: have to wait for five more minutes, and
option_4: the train is going to come to the station within five minutes.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option D - the train is going to come to the station within five minutes.

The final part of the sentence needlessly repeats information already conveyed earlier ('we have to wait for five more minutes'), making the sentence redundant and poorly constructed. This repetitive/redundant phrasing is the error, so option D is the part that needs correction.

question:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively and are fixed in their positions. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. The sailor took home his gold, made his ship ready, and then, taking leave of his wife and sons, he went down to the shore, where he found the old man waiting for him with a slave and twenty ass-loads of empty sacks, Abu'l Fawaris greeted him, and together they loaded the ship and set sail. A. For this the old man steered, and they soon landed upon it. B. This they reached after some hours of travel and climbed to the summit, upon which they found a broad plain where more than two hundred pits had been dug. C. Having loaded his slave with some sacks, the old man with his companions set out towards a mountain which they could see in the distance. D. Taking a particular star for their mark, they sailed for three months, when an island appeared to one side of them. S2. The old man then explained to the sailor that he was a merchant and that he had, on that spot, found a mine of jewels.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - DACB.

S1 ends with the ship setting sail, so D logically follows, describing the voyage guided by a star until an island appears. A follows, describing the old man steering towards and landing on the island. C then describes the old man loading his slave with sacks and setting out towards a mountain. B follows, describing their climb to the summit and the plain full of pits, leading naturally into S2's explanation of the jewel mine. The correct sequence is D-A-C-B.

question:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively and are fixed in their positions. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. And addressing another eunuch, he said to him, O my chief, as thou hopest for Allah's protection, tell me, am I the Prince of the Faithful? A. And Abou Hassan, perplexed at all that he beheld, said, In one night do I become Prince of the Faithful! B. He remained perplexed and confounded until the morning, when a eunuch advanced to him and said to him, May Allah grant a happy morning to the Prince of the Faithful! C. Yea, by Allah, answered the eunuch; thou art at this present time the Prince of the Faithful and the caliph of the Lord of all creatures. D. Was I not yesterday Abou Hassan, and today am I the Prince of the Faithful? S2. And he handed to him a pair of shoes of gold stuff, reticulated with precious stones and rubies; and Abou Hassan took them, and after examining them a long time, put them into his sleeve.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option C - CADB.

S1 has the speaker asking whether he is truly the Prince of the Faithful. C follows naturally, with the eunuch affirming that he indeed is. A follows, showing Abou Hassan's astonishment at this claim. D continues his confusion, questioning whether he was Abou Hassan just yesterday. B then describes how he remained perplexed until morning, when another eunuch greeted him as Prince, leading into S2's description of the gift of shoes. The correct sequence is C-A-D-B.

question:
Given below are six sentences taken from a paragraph. The first and the last sentences are numbered S1 and S2 and are placed in the first and last positions respectively and are fixed in their positions. The other four sentences between the first and last sentences are jumbled up and are numbered A, B, C, and D. Rearrange the jumbled sentences in a logical sequence keeping the unity and coherence of the paragraph intact. Choose the correct alternative that best describes the sequence.

S1. Saidjah, who was then about seven, soon made friends with the new buffalo. A. Such a friendship the little Saidjah had soon been able to make with the newcomer; and it seemed as if the encouraging voice of the child gave more strength to the heavy shoulders of the animal, when it tore open the stiff clay and traced its way in deep sharp furrows. B. Of his attachment I shall soon give an example. C. The large strong animal bends its heavy head to the right, to the left, or downwards, just as the pressure of the child's finger directs. D. I purposely say “made friends,” for it was indeed touching to see how the buffalo was attached to the little boy who watched over and fed him. S2. The buffalo turned willingly on reaching the end of the field, not losing an inch of ground when plowing backwards the new furrow, which was ever near the old, as if the sawah was a garden ground raked by a giant.
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option A - DBCA.

S1 introduces the friendship between Saidjah and the buffalo. D naturally follows, explaining why the phrase 'made friends' was used, noting the buffalo's attachment to the boy. B follows, promising an example of this attachment. C then illustrates the buffalo's obedience to the child's gentle guidance. A follows, elaborating on the friendship and how the child's encouraging voice strengthened the animal's efforts, leading into S2's description of the buffalo's continued willing work. The correct sequence is D-B-C-A.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on the passage:

 

Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

What led Antonin Artaud to develop the Theatre of Cruelty?
option_1: His rejection of traditional realism and his desire to create a theatre based on calm, reflective storytelling
option_2: His interest in psychological naturalism inspired by Stanislavsky's methods of acting
option_3: His attempt to revive classical Greek theatre and restore its poetic structure
option_4: His departure from Surrealism, which pushed him toward formulating a radical, sensory-driven performance style
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option D - His departure from Surrealism, which pushed him toward formulating a radical, sensory-driven performance style.

The passage states that Artaud's 'eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories'. This directly matches option D - it was his break from Surrealism that led him to formulate this radical, intensely sensory style of theatre.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on the passage:

 

Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

What was one of the central goals of Artaud's Theatre of Cruelty?
option_1: To continue the illusion of a realistic world on the stage
option_2: To produce touching drama that concerned only the emotions of the characters
option_3: To shock the audience out of passive viewing and provoke a psychological response
option_4: To amuse spectators with humorous comedy and clever dialogue
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option C - To shock the audience out of passive viewing and provoke a psychological response.

The passage states that Artaud's technical effects were meant 'to strike the audience's emotions and senses' and to make them 'face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain', with the overall aim of leaving 'a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience'. This shows his goal was to jolt/shock the audience out of passive spectatorship, matching option C.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on the passage:

 

Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

How did Artaud redefine the relationship between performer and audience?
option_1: By having actors stay only on the stage to keep a sense of distance
option_2: By taking away barriers and putting performers right among the audience
option_3: By using heavy curtains and screens to separate the space and prevent distractions
option_4: By saying the audience should stay passive during the performance
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option B - By taking away barriers and putting performers right among the audience.

The passage explicitly states that Artaud 'removed the barrier between the performers and the audience', which directly matches option B - he did away with the traditional separation, bringing performers into close proximity with the audience.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on the passage:

 

Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

Which elements of stagecraft did Artaud use to create his intense sensory environment?
option_1: Giant props, sudden lights, and loud noises, with shouting and singing,
option_2: Opera music, real-looking props, and life-like lighting to keep the old theatre styles
option_3: Fragile symbolic movements and silent talking to stir minor emotional changes
option_4: Little light, quiet voices, and a simple visual design to make a meditative calm
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option A - Giant props, sudden lights, and loud noises, with shouting and singing,.

The passage states that Artaud 'made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations' to overwhelm the audience's senses. This matches option A, which paraphrases these same elements as giant props, sudden lights, and loud noises with shouting/vocalisation.

question:
Read the following passage carefully and answer the questions based on the passage:

 

Antonin Artaud was associated with Surrealism and avant-garde theatre. His eventual departure from Surrealism made him develop the Theatre of Cruelty and publish its theories in the work called Theatre and Its Double. He removed the barrier between the performers and the audience. He made use of oversized props, lightning effects, groans, screams and verbal incantations to strike the audience's emotions and senses with an array of technical effects in order to make them face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain. The whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience.

What was the final effect desired by Artaud with his Theatre of Cruelty?
option_1: A soft, self-searching experience that lets people be calm and amused by the plot
option_2: A total perceptual experience that was merely concerned with the elements of beauty and harmony
option_3: A revival of the classical traditions alongside the use of familiar dramatic forms
option_4: A permanent mental impact that compels the public to face the hard truths
solution_text:
Correct Answer: Option D - A permanent mental impact that compels the public to face the hard truths.

The passage concludes that 'the whole idea of the theatre of cruelty was to leave a lasting impact on the psychology of the audience', and describes how it forced the audience 'to face the unreal, ugly and grotesque pain'. This matches option D - a permanent psychological impact compelling the audience to confront difficult truths.

question: स्वतंत्रता के बाद नेहरू ने समाजवाद के सोवियत मॉडल (Soviet model of socialism) को क्यों अस्वीकार किया?
option_1: विकेंद्रीकरण (decentralisation) को बढ़ावा देने के कारण।
option_2: अर्थव्यवस्था में निजी खिलाड़ियों की व्यापक भूमिका के जुड़ाव के कारण।
option_3: क्योंकि यह केवल कृषि पर निर्भर था।
option_4: क्योंकि इस मॉडल में देश के सभी कारखाने और खेत सरकार के स्वामित्व में थे।
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प D - क्योंकि इस मॉडल में देश के सभी कारखाने और खेत सरकार के स्वामित्व में थे।

नेहरू ने संपूर्ण राज्य स्वामित्व के सोवियत मॉडल के बजाय भारत के लिए एक 'मिश्रित अर्थव्यवस्था' मॉडल को पसंद किया। सोवियत मॉडल में सभी कारखानों और खेतों का पूर्ण सरकारी स्वामित्व शामिल था, जिसे नेहरू भारत के लोकतांत्रिक और बहुलवादी ढांचे के लिए अनुपयुक्त मानते थे; इसके बजाय उन्होंने सार्वजनिक और निजी क्षेत्रों के सह-अस्तित्व की अनुमति दी।

question: तैमूर (Timur) ने किस वर्ष दिल्ली पर कब्ज़ा किया था?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प B - 1398।

तैमूर (तैमूरलंग), मध्य एशियाई विजेता, ने कमजोर तुगलक शासक नासिरुद्दीन महमूद शाह के शासनकाल के दौरान 1398 में भारत पर आक्रमण किया और दिल्ली पर कब्ज़ा कर लिया, जिसने शहर को लूटा और उसके निवासियों का नरसंहार किया।

question: रामानुज ______ से गहराई से प्रभावित थे।
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - आलवार (Alvars)।

रामानुज, महान वैष्णव दार्शनिक-संत और विशिष्टाद्वैत के प्रतिपादक, आलवार से गहराई से प्रभावित थे - तमिल वैष्णव भक्ति कवि-संत जिनके भक्ति स्तोत्रों ने दक्षिण भारतीय वैष्णव धर्म को आकार दिया।

question: प्रकाश संश्लेषण (photosynthesis) की प्रक्रिया में पहला चरण क्या है?
option_1: क्लोरोफिल द्वारा प्रकाश ऊर्जा का अवशोषण
option_2: प्रकाश ऊर्जा का रासायनिक ऊर्जा में रूपांतरण
option_3: कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड का कार्बोहाइड्रेट में अपचयन (reduction)
option_4: जल अणुओं का हाइड्रोजन और ऑक्सीजन में विभाजन
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - क्लोरोफिल द्वारा प्रकाश ऊर्जा का अवशोषण।

प्रकाश संश्लेषण की शुरुआत हरितलवक (chloroplasts) में मौजूद क्लोरोफिल और अन्य वर्णकों (pigments) द्वारा प्रकाश ऊर्जा के अवशोषण से होती है। यह अवशोषित प्रकाश ऊर्जा बाद में रासायनिक ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित होती है, जो फिर जल के विभाजन और कार्बन डाइऑक्साइड के स्थिरीकरण को संचालित करती है।

question: 'भीमबेटका' (Bhimbetka), पुरानी गुफा चित्रों वाला मध्यपाषाण युग (Mesolithic Age) का एक स्थल, किस राज्य में है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प D - मध्य प्रदेश।

भीमबेटका शैलाश्रय (rock shelters), मध्य प्रदेश में स्थित एक UNESCO विश्व धरोहर स्थल, में भारत की कुछ सबसे पुरानी ज्ञात शैल कला (rock art) है, जिनके चित्र मध्यपाषाण काल से लेकर ऐतिहासिक काल तक के हैं।

question: आलमगीरपुर, एक हड़प्पा शहर, आधुनिक भारत के किस राज्य में स्थित है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - उत्तर प्रदेश।

उत्तर प्रदेश के मेरठ जिले में हिंडन नदी के किनारे स्थित आलमगीरपुर को आमतौर पर अब तक खोजी गई सिंधु घाटी (हड़प्पा) सभ्यता का सबसे पूर्वी स्थल माना जाता है।

question: 'यक्षगान' (Yakshagana) निम्नलिखित में से किस भारतीय राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश का लोकप्रिय नृत्य है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - कर्नाटक।

यक्षगान तटीय कर्नाटक का एक पारंपरिक नृत्य-नाटक रूप है, जो हिंदू महाकाव्यों और पुराणों की कहानियों को प्रस्तुत करने के लिए नृत्य, संगीत, विस्तृत वेशभूषा, और संवाद को मिलाता है।

question: चेचक (pox) से सुरक्षा के लिए देवी को प्रसन्न करने हेतु 'काकड़ा नृत्य' (Kaakda Nritya) किस राज्य में प्रस्तुत किया जाता है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - गुजरात।

काकड़ा नृत्य गुजरात में प्रस्तुत किया जाने वाला एक लोक अनुष्ठान नृत्य है, जो परंपरागत रूप से उस देवी को प्रसन्न करने के लिए किया जाता है जिसके बारे में माना जाता है कि वे चेचक और अन्य पॉक्स-संबंधी बीमारियों से सुरक्षा प्रदान करती हैं।

question: आदिवासी संस्कृति और विरासत को प्रदर्शित करने के लिए प्रसिद्ध 'हॉर्नबिल' त्योहार भारत के किस राज्य/केंद्र शासित प्रदेश में आयोजित किया जाता है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - नागालैंड।

हॉर्नबिल त्योहार नागालैंड में (कोहिमा के पास किसामा हेरिटेज विलेज में) प्रत्येक दिसंबर में आयोजित होने वाला एक वार्षिक सांस्कृतिक त्योहार है, जो राज्य की विभिन्न जनजातियों, उनकी परंपराओं, संगीत, शिल्प, और व्यंजनों को प्रदर्शित करता है।

question: सिक्किम राज्य में कौन सा त्योहार 'तिहार' (Tihar) के रूप में मनाया जाता है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - दिवाली।

'तिहार' दिवाली (दीपावली), रोशनी के त्योहार, का नेपाली नाम है, जो सिक्किम और पड़ोसी पहाड़ी क्षेत्रों की नेपाली भाषी जनसंख्या द्वारा व्यापक रूप से मनाया जाता है।

question: निम्नलिखित में से किसने 1765 में ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी की ओर से मुगल शासक से बिहार और उड़ीसा की दीवानी (Diwani) स्वीकार की?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - रॉबर्ट क्लाइव।

इलाहाबाद की संधि (1765) के बाद, रॉबर्ट क्लाइव ने ईस्ट इंडिया कंपनी की ओर से मुगल सम्राट शाह आलम द्वितीय से बंगाल, बिहार, और उड़ीसा की दीवानी (राजस्व वसूलने का अधिकार) स्वीकार की।

question: वेरावल के नाम पर रखा गया राग 'बिलावल' (Bilaval) परंपरागत रूप से किस भारतीय राज्य से जुड़ा है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प B - गुजरात।

राग बिलावल के बारे में परंपरागत रूप से माना जाता है कि इसका नाम गुजरात के एक बंदरगाह शहर वेरावल से लिया गया है, और भारतीय शास्त्रीय संगीत परंपरा में इसे उस क्षेत्र से जोड़ा जाता है।

question: लोकसभा में अनुसूचित जनजातियों (Scheduled Tribes) के लिए कितनी सीटें आरक्षित थीं?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - 47।

लोकसभा की 543 निर्वाचित सीटों में से, 84 सीटें अनुसूचित जातियों (SC) के लिए और 47 सीटें अनुसूचित जनजातियों (ST) के लिए आरक्षित हैं, जो विधायिका में आरक्षण के लिए संवैधानिक प्रावधानों के अनुसार है।

question: 1870 के दशक में मातृभूमि के लिए एक स्तोत्र के रूप में 'वंदे मातरम्' किसने लिखा था?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प D - बंकिम चंद्र चट्टोपाध्याय।

'वंदे मातरम्' की रचना बंकिम चंद्र चट्टोपाध्याय ने 1870 के दशक में की थी और बाद में इसे उनके उपन्यास आनंदमठ (1882) में शामिल किया गया। यह भारतीय स्वतंत्रता आंदोलन का एक रैली-नारा और भारत का राष्ट्रीय गीत बन गया।

question: बादल की गड़गड़ाहट (rolling of thunder) क्यों होती है?
option_1: ध्वनि तरंगों के एकल परावर्तन के कारण
option_2: बादलों द्वारा ध्वनि तरंगों के अवशोषण के कारण
option_3: कई परावर्तक सतहों से ध्वनि के लगातार परावर्तनों के कारण
option_4: प्रकाश तरंगों के प्रकीर्णन के कारण
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - कई परावर्तक सतहों से ध्वनि के लगातार परावर्तनों के कारण।

बिजली गिरने से उत्पन्न लंबी, गड़गड़ाहट वाली ध्वनि बादलों, पहाड़ियों, इमारतों, और अलग-अलग दूरी पर स्थित अन्य सतहों से कई बार परावर्तित होने के कारण होती है, जिससे ध्वनि सुनने वाले तक एक तेज तड़क के बजाय क्रमिक प्रतिध्वनियों की एक श्रृंखला के रूप में पहुँचती है।

question: कृषि योग्य बंजर भूमि (culturable wasteland) वह भूमि है जिसे ______ के लिए परती (fallow) छोड़ दिया गया हो।
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - पाँच वर्ष से अधिक।

भारत के भूमि-उपयोग वर्गीकरण के अनुसार, 'कृषि योग्य बंजर भूमि' उस भूमि को संदर्भित करती है जो खेती के लिए उपयुक्त है परंतु लगातार पाँच वर्ष से अधिक समय तक अकृषित/परती छोड़ी गई है।

question: विदेशी विनिमय दर (foreign exchange rate) क्या है?
option_1: यह एक मुद्रा की दूसरी मुद्रा के संदर्भ में कीमत है।
option_2: सार्वजनिक बैंकों द्वारा लिया जाने वाला ब्याज दर।
option_4: अंतरराष्ट्रीय मुद्रा कोष द्वारा लिया जाने वाला ब्याज दर।
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - यह एक मुद्रा की दूसरी मुद्रा के संदर्भ में कीमत है।

विदेशी विनिमय दर किसी देश की मुद्रा का दूसरी मुद्रा के संदर्भ में व्यक्त किया गया मूल्य या कीमत है, जो यह निर्धारित करती है कि एक मुद्रा की कितनी मात्रा दूसरी मुद्रा की एक इकाई के लिए विनिमय की जा सकती है।

question: पुस्तक 'दिल्ली: ए नॉवेल' (Delhi: A Novel) के लेखक कौन हैं?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - खुशवंत सिंह।

'दिल्ली: ए नॉवेल' (1990), एक ऐतिहासिक उपन्यास जो कई सदियों में दिल्ली की कहानी का पता लगाता है, प्रसिद्ध भारतीय लेखक और पत्रकार खुशवंत सिंह द्वारा लिखा गया था।

question: पुस्तक 'इंदिरा गांधी: ट्रिस्ट विद पावर' (Indira Gandhi: Tryst with Power) निम्नलिखित में से किसकी लिखी हुई एक जीवनी है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प D - नयनतारा सहगल।

'इंदिरा गांधी: ट्रिस्ट विद पावर' पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री की एक जीवनी है जिसे नयनतारा सहगल ने लिखा, जो स्वयं इंदिरा गांधी की चचेरी बहन और एक प्रसिद्ध लेखिका थीं।

question: गोलकोंडा किला (Golconda Fort) किस शहर में स्थित है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प A - हैदराबाद।

गोलकोंडा किला तेलंगाना के हैदराबाद में स्थित एक ऐतिहासिक किला है, जो कुतुब शाही वंश की राजधानी के रूप में कार्य करता था और इसके आसपास किए जाने वाले हीरे के व्यापार के लिए प्रसिद्ध था।

question: यूरोपीयों ने गोवा में बंदरगाह शहर पणजी की स्थापना निम्नलिखित में से किस वर्ष की थी?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - 1510।

पुर्तगालियों ने, अफोंसो डी अल्बुकर्क के नेतृत्व में, 1510 में गोवा पर विजय प्राप्त की और बाद में पणजी को एक बंदरगाह शहर के रूप में विकसित किया, जो बाद में पुर्तगाली भारत की राजधानी बना।

question: खाद्य श्रृंखला (food chain) में विभिन्न पोषी स्तरों (trophic levels) से गुजरते हुए ऊर्जा के साथ क्या होता है?
option_1: यह पूर्ण रूप से रासायनिक ऊर्जा में परिवर्तित हो जाती है
option_2: यह जीवों द्वारा पूर्ण रूप से उपयोग की जाती है
option_3: यह सभी पोषी स्तरों में अनिश्चित काल तक संग्रहीत रहती है
option_4: कुछ ऊर्जा पर्यावरण में नष्ट हो जाती है
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प D - कुछ ऊर्जा पर्यावरण में नष्ट हो जाती है।

ऊर्जा प्रवाह के दस प्रतिशत नियम (ten percent law) के अनुसार, एक पोषी स्तर पर मौजूद ऊर्जा का केवल लगभग 10% अगले स्तर पर स्थानांतरित होता है; शेष पर्यावरण में मुख्यतः श्वसन और अन्य उपापचयी प्रक्रियाओं के दौरान ऊष्मा के रूप में नष्ट हो जाता है, यही कारण है कि खाद्य श्रृंखलाएँ शायद ही कभी चार या पाँच पोषी स्तरों से आगे बढ़ती हैं।

question: ऐसा कहा जाता है कि आज ज्ञात दक्षिण भारतीय संगीत मध्यकाल में यादवों की राजधानी शहर ______ में फला-फूला।
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - देवगिरी।

देवगिरी (वर्तमान महाराष्ट्र में दौलताबाद) यादव वंश की राजधानी थी, और ऐसा कहा जाता है कि आज ज्ञात दक्षिण भारतीय (कर्नाटक) संगीत मध्यकाल के दौरान वहाँ महत्वपूर्ण रूप से फला-फूला।

question:
निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा पेट्रोलियम का एक घटक है?

I. डीजल

II. पैराफिन मोम (Paraffin wax)
option_4: न तो I न ही II
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प C - I और II दोनों।

पेट्रोलियम, भिन्नात्मक आसवन (fractional distillation) पर, पेट्रोल, मिट्टी का तेल, और स्नेहक तेल जैसे अन्य भिन्नों के साथ-साथ डीजल और पैराफिन मोम सहित कई उत्पाद देता है। अतः डीजल और पैराफिन मोम दोनों पेट्रोलियम से प्राप्त घटक हैं।

question: निम्नलिखित में से कौन सा अंगक (organelle) प्रोटीन निर्माण का स्थल है?
solution_text:
सही उत्तर: विकल्प D - राइबोसोम (Ribosomes)।

राइबोसोम, जो या तो कोशिकाद्रव्य में स्वतंत्र रूप से पाए जाते हैं या खुरदरी अंतर्द्रव्यी जालिका से जुड़े होते हैं, वे कोशिका अंगक हैं जो मैसेंजर RNA को पॉलीपेप्टाइड श्रृंखलाओं में अनुवादित करके प्रोटीन संश्लेषण (निर्माण) के लिए जिम्मेदार हैं।
